question: Can anchor-conditioned boundary credits correct false absence nominations and improve downstream acquisition at the same mask budget?
primary: Patient-macro small-positive recall at retrospective 20% all-absence FPR, anchored versus image difference, same fixed top-1% presence score as the earlier audit
proposal_audit: Anchor and local allocation share the same view, area, image-distance and coverage rules. Compare selected small and adjacent reference-absence counts per 80 new masks; compare exact boundary precision for their 50 highest-scoring nominations per fold across both phases and report the full available support.
secondary_metrics: FPR and recall at independent source cutoffs
scope: Development first; official ACDC 50 and the same-source reserve have already appeared in earlier analyses. If used here, they are locked retrospective evaluations, not fresh validation.
labels: Only the same two central training masks are visible to each selector. Evaluation labels and calibration labels are separate. The segmenter, loss, seed, update budget and calibration protocol are shared.
inference: Bootstrap patients paired across method and seed, stratified by development fold, or average two official fits over the same test roster. Keep separate seed point estimates and avoid interpreting fixed-seed intervals as training uncertainty.
